controller_contract.physical_budget: same global physical hot-block total per sequence for the paired policies at each scale and budget
controller_contract.batching: one controller-enabled cache over the concatenated batch x concurrency tensor; per-layer physical quotas scale by batch x concurrency

configured and observed per-layer physical hot blocks
protected pin set and global hot-memory equality

required_measurements: raw request admission, first-token, completion, and per-token decode execution timestamps
TTFT, TPOT, end-to-end p50/p95/p99 and maximum

logical, hot, cold, tier-hot, and pinned-host cache bytes
H2D, D2H, useful-transfer bytes and counts, misses, late misses, prefetches, and evictions
configured and observed per-layer physical hot budgets
prediction digests without requiring equality between causal policies
OOM, timeout, numerical failure, and unexpected exception records

statistical_analysis.unit: paired repetition within a frozen cell
estimands: calibrated-minus-fixed controller time, transfer bytes, late misses, and terminal failures
statistical_analysis.multiplicity: Holm correction within each metric family across the 432 frozen cells
statistical_analysis.failure_policy: intention-to-measure; every terminal failure remains in the primary table and is never silently retried or dropped

claim_boundary: This cohort tests the exact P2 fixed+pins and calibrated+pins controllers in simultaneous real GPU batches with request overlap. The checked adapter admits every request at cell start, so it does not establish dynamic arrivals, continuous admission, request eviction, fused kernels, multi-GPU serving, Qwen runtime transfer, official DeepSeek-V4, FlashMemory, or IndexCache superiority. Quality claims remain bound to P2 and P3 rather than random-token P4 predictions.
